comment: The single source of truth for the required-check set on main.
Consumed by the Dependabot auto-merge guard today and by the release
chain's source-admission stage when it lands. The GitHub ruleset
(main-protection) must match this list EXACTLY - contexts and
integration IDs both; the guard fails closed on any difference in
either direction. integration_id 15368 is GitHub Actions: it pins each
context to check runs produced by Actions, so a check run with the
same name from any other app does not satisfy the requirement.
Editing this list does not change the ruleset; only the owner can do
that, in the GitHub UI. Edit here first, then the owner updates the
ruleset to match - the guard stays red in between, which is the
scope: 'push' means the check runs on main commits and release
admission requires it green on the exact tagged SHA; 'pull_request'
means it only ever runs on PRs, so admission requires it green on
the head of the merged PR that produced the tagged commit (F02).
